If you have any questions or concerns regarding this incident, please get in touch with us by logging into https://support.otava.com or calling 877-740-5028, option 3.

MM1 - Internet Connectivity Degradation - 5/13/2026 [postmortem]
item.description:
Event: The Mid-Michigan \(MM\) data center experienced a Denial of Service \(DoS\) event impacting connectivity to the data center.
Start Time: 5-13-2026, Wednesday 7:13 PM ET
Resolved Time: 5-18-2025 , Monday 3:40 PM ET
Cause: A Denial of Service \(DoS\) event impacted network connectivity at the Mid-Michigan site.
Resolution: Internet Service Provider \(ISP\) and OTAVA engineers implemented routing and networking configuration changes such as geoblocking, Access Control Lists \(ACL\) changes, black hole routing and service provider AI-Powered DoS Protection.
More information will be provided when the RCA is available.
